Market today: The mood is cautious, driven by rising oil prices and 10-year Treasury yields, which are fueling inflation fears and increasing the likelihood of a Fed rate hike next week. This macro environment is a headwind for your concentrated tech/chip book, as higher rates typically hurt growth stocks.

Your holdings: Your leveraged ETFs, SOXL (-53.87%) and SPAL (-30.44%), are in deep drawdown and flagged "SELL." Given you're on margin, these positions amplify risk significantly and need immediate attention. SMH (-11.54%) is also a concern with its double-digit loss and "TRIM" status.

Watch: Keep a close eye on oil prices and the 10-year Treasury yield for further moves, as well as any pre-Fed commentary. Respect your stops, especially on the leveraged positions.

Bottom line: Focus on aggressive risk management and protecting capital in this challenging macro environment.
plays: Trim SOXL and SPAL. These leveraged ETFs are deep in the red and flagged "SELL," amplifying risk on margin.
Review SMH, down 11.54% and flagged "TRIM." Consider reducing exposure to manage risk in this environment.
No new buys today - hold and watch. Macro headwinds suggest caution over initiating new positions.
